title: Automate KMS + TLS certificate rotation for private installer (Vault/SealedSecrets + HSM support)
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Private deployments require automated, auditable rotation of TLS certificates and KMS keys to meet compliance SLAs and reduce manual ops. This PR implements an end-to-end rotation flow for private installer deployments using Vault as the primary KMS/PKI backend with optional AWS CloudHSM support and integration with SealedSecrets for Kubernetes secret lifecycle. Design summary: (1) Add a rotation controller in the installer that orchestrates certificate renewal, key rotation, and staged rollout across control-plane components and gateways. (2) Introduce Terraform modules to provision Vault PKI roles, HSM-backed KMS keys, and rotation schedules. (3) Helm chart changes: add chart hooks and rollout annotations to coordinate pod restarts and zero-downtime reloads. (4) SealedSecrets integration: automated unseal/reseal dance and CI-safe sealed secret artifacts for upgraded clusters. (5) Rollback and upgrade tooling: a new cli subcommand (installer rotate --dry-run/--apply/--rollback) with safe checkpoints and audit logging. Implementation details: - Vault PKI: new terraform/modules/vault-pki module that creates a root/intermediate authority, roles for node/gateway certs, and TTL policies. The module supports Vault auto-renew and defines sample rotation policies. - HSM integration: terraform/modules/kms-hsm adds CloudHSM cluster and key aliases; the installer supports kms:// and hsm:// key URIs and will use CloudHSM via the Vault Transit plugin when configured. - Helm: charts/control-plane/templates/rotation-job.yaml and charts/gateway/templates/cert-reloader.yaml implement the in-cluster jobs for seamless certificate reloads. Charts add values.rotation.enabled, values.rotation.gracePeriod, and values.rotation.strategy (rolling/eager). - SealedSecrets: kubectl-sealed integration for CI pipelines; secrets are re-sealed after rotation with new root cert fingerprint. - CLI: installer rotation implements state checkpoints in S3-compatible object storage (required in private mode) and emits per-step audit events to the cluster audit log. - Safety: preflight checks verify compatibility matrix (k8s version, helm version, Vault version), and a canary stage rotates a single gateway before full rollout. Migration path: when upgrading from installer v1.x the migration script creates required Vault roles and re-seals secrets using the current installer identity; users with external KMS can opt-out with values.rotation.external=true. Testing: e2e test harness added to perf-canary that simulates certificate expiry, Vault failover, and HSM key rotation; integration tests added to ci/rotation pipeline. Rollback: rotation checkpoints allow rollback to the previous certificate bundle; the CLI exposes --rollback-to <checkpoint-id>. Security considerations: sealed secrets are rotated without ever exposing plaintext in CI; Vault policies are least-privilege; rotation operations require a rotation role bound to the installer service account. Checklist: [x] Terraform modules for Vault/KMS/HSM [x] Helm chart hooks and reloader [x] Installer CLI commands and checkpoints [x] SealedSecrets CI flows [x] e2e tests + perf canary [x] Documentation and upgrade notes Files changed (high level) and commit summary included below.
